notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content: Improvements in the text and the main screen menu.

notes.title: Major Update Alert! Dive into a Brand-New Journey in KONCOLOS
notes.content:
What's New:

New Storyline: We've prepared a special story update for you! Our team has been hard at work crafting a new tale for the world of Koncolos and its monster hunters. This fresh narrative aims to retell the adventurers of the monster hunters with a new perspective. We believe that this new story will take you to a more intimate and truly connectable world.

Character Design Revamp: We're thrilled to share our character design updates with you! Our team has given our characters a fresh new look. With these enhanced visuals, we hope their personalities will shine even brighter, and we're excited for their interactions to become even more enjoyable.

With gratitude...

notes.title: Major Update: Music
notes.content:
Added volume adjustment feature to the in-game menu for soundtrack.
Added change song button.
New tracks have been added and the track list has been updated.
Added ambient sounds.

notes.title: Minor Update 1.031
notes.content:
Bugs in graphics and camera transitions have been fixed.

Some spelling errors are corrected.

notes.title: Major Update 1.03: Achievements
notes.content: Koncolos is a visual novel that offers players choices. With this update, you will be able to earn one of three achievements at the end of the game, based on the choices you make. Enjoy.
